meta.title: 3-Day Atlas Mountains & Agafay Group Escape | Shared Morocco Adventures
meta.description: A 3-day shared group escape from Marrakech into the High Atlas foothills and Agafay stone desert, with a sunset camel ride and desert camp night. From €219pp.
meta.ogDescription: A shared, fixed-date group escape from Marrakech — Atlas Mountain villages, a valley walk, and a sunset camel ride and camp night in the Agafay desert. From €219pp.

hero.lead: Marrakech → High Atlas Foothills → Agafay Stone Desert → Marrakech

overview.h2: A short, sociable escape from the city
paras: This is our shortest route — ideal if you only have a long weekend, or want a taster before committing to a longer desert trip. In three days you'll trade Marrakech's medina for mountain air in the High Atlas foothills, then swap peaks for dunes in the Agafay stone desert, all with a small group of fellow travelers.
Total driving distance is around 195 km, kept deliberately short so most of your time is spent walking, exploring, or relaxing rather than sitting in a minivan.

days.label: Mountains
days.title: Marrakech to the High Atlas foothills
paras: Morning group pickup in Marrakech and a short drive up into the High Atlas foothills near Imlil. Guided walk through terraced Berber villages and walnut groves, with a stop for mint tea with a local family. Overnight in a simple mountain guesthouse.

days.label: Desert
days.title: Atlas foothills to the Agafay stone desert
paras: Descend from the mountains and cross to the Agafay stone desert, a rocky plateau with sweeping High Atlas views. Afternoon camel ride across the plateau, followed by mint tea and a shared dinner at the desert camp as the sun sets over the dunes.

days.label: Return
days.title: Agafay desert back to Marrakech
paras: Optional sunrise walk over the plateau before breakfast at camp. Short drive back to Marrakech, arriving by late morning with the rest of the day free. Trip ends.

intro: Two nights, shared throughout to keep the price down. Rooms are simple and clean rather than luxurious — expect the same style and price bracket as these real budget properties in each location.

cards.title: Night 1 · Atlas foothills
html: A family-run Berber guesthouse in the Imlil valley, similar in style and price to trekking lodges used by budget operators in the area — shared twin rooms, home-cooked tagine dinner, mountain views from the terrace.

cards.title: Night 2 · Agafay Desert
html: A shared Berber-style desert camp on the Agafay plateau, in the same bracket as dorm-tent camps like Selina Agafay Nomad Camp — simple bedded tents, shared bathrooms, campfire dinner under the stars.

cards.title: Private upgrade
html: Want your own room or tent instead of sharing? Let us know when booking — private accommodation is available on both nights as a paid upgrade, subject to availability.

includes: Shared transport in an air-conditioned minivan
Guided Atlas valley walk and camel ride
Breakfast daily and 1 dinner at the desert camp
excludes: Private rooms (available on request, extra cost)

paras: Groups are capped at 16 travelers. Departures run every Friday year-round, making this an easy weekend add-on either side of a longer stay in Marrakech.
This trip pairs well with our day trips from Marrakech if you'd rather build a longer custom stay — ask us about combining routes.
Booking terms: Send an enquiry first; we confirm the departure, final price, and payment instructions by email. No payment is taken through this website.

items.a: The Atlas valley walk is a gentle 2–3 hour route on village paths, suitable for most fitness levels. No technical trekking gear is needed.

items.q: Is this different from the Agafay Desert day trip?
items.a: Yes — this 3-day route adds an overnight in the Atlas foothills and an overnight desert camp stay, rather than a single afternoon visit. It's a fuller version of our Agafay Desert day trip.
Layers for cool mountain and desert-night temperatures, comfortable walking shoes, sunscreen, and a scarf or hat for sun and wind.
Yes, most travelers on this route join solo. You'll be paired with a same-gender roommate for shared rooms unless you book a private upgrade.

items.q: What if the group doesn't fill up?
items.a: Departures run on fixed weekly dates regardless of group size — your trip runs even if only a few seats are booked.
